preconditions.description: The input `s` must be a string.
All characters in the string `s` must be lowercase.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (all(s[i] <= s[i+1] for i in range(len(s)-1)) if len(s) > 1 else True)
postconditions.description: The function returns `True` if the string `s` is in alphabetical order, otherwise `False`.
